brief: Asymmetric Transylvanian castle with mapped open courtyard, round western tower, steep single-slope keep roof, scalloped rear parapet and timber belfry, projecting eastern tower chamber, south stair turret, arched galleries, well and entrance stairs.

nativeAxes.origin: Retained signed castle anchor; Y0 decoded 764.9841 m numeric working datum.

sourceFacts.identity: Exact Q390275 match on OSM relation/3300200

reconstruction.basis: OSM outer/inner rings and five tower/roof parts; official historical chronology and visitor map; exterior and courtyard photographs.
reconstruction.verticalDatum: Fresh exact-Q390275 relation 3300200 v30 and seven outer, court and roof/tower ways match retained coordinates within 0.672 mm. Native +X southeast at 129.515 degrees, +Z southwest at 219.515 degrees. Round western tower, northeast keep/belfry, eastern tower and southwest stair/entrance sign the frame. Retained Terrarium public numeric terrain and a 4225-value 4 m native grid establish contact against one viewer terrain product. Y0 is the decoded 764.9841 m anchor working datum; no regional survey or ellipsoid conversion is asserted. Reconstructed courtyard floor 3.849 m above that datum uses highest mapped outer-boundary sample plus 0.25 m. Architecture receives one rigid -0.151 m translation from the original court basis; footprints and vertical proportions remain intact. Occupied perimeter feet extend 4 m below sampled terrain, court paving stays a thin architectural slab, and host terrain supplies the geological knoll. Whole-precinct replacement/cutout remains disabled. Coarse terrain cannot establish precise cliff or architectural elevations; local Romanian public terrain service was unreachable.
reconstruction.roofscape: Hand-authored red-tile facets; exact roof valleys and heights remain provisional.

limitations: Original 145600-triangle / 13770396-byte master remains preserved and reproducible at sha256:1d40b097ab6f1765fa729f7b06db09811704bac68fee1c3ed384422ff4987bff from bran-castle-model.mjs#branStudy.build. Independent medium-fi derivative retains the exterior while replacing the provisional four-meter rock contact with mapped feet and an explicit relative terrain reference.

OSM height tags 50–73 m have unresolved datum and are not facade survey heights. Keep roof, belfry, tower eaves, scallops and roof valley heights retain photograph-derived relative proportions.

Terrarium tile pixels and 4 m native review samples are not source DEM resolution or vertical accuracy. Small cliff, steps and under-building ground can be smoothed or contaminated; no local LiDAR accuracy, current terrain vintage or universal host compatibility claim.

Shared granite, limestone, plaster, timber, ceramic and painted-metal graphs; recesses share tinted plaster. Local opaque PBR glass and baked common skyline means avoid embedded images. Fine weathering and distinctive rounded tile ends are simplified.

Current exterior/courtyard reconstruction excludes interior rooms, artwork, furniture, underground Time Tunnel, temporary visitor equipment, surrounding park/forest and village. Courtyard masonry, gallery, well ironwork and window locations remain photograph-guided approximations. Physical phone/laptop timings remain unmeasured.
